business_summary: China HK Power Smart Energy Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the sales and distribution of natural gas (NG), liquefied natural gas (LNG), and pipeline natural gas (PNG) in the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong. It operates through three segments: NG Business, New Energy Business, and Financial Services. The company is involved in the wholesale of LNG and PNG; point-to-point supply of LNG through industrial gasification stations, dewar bottle filling stations and automobile gas stations, and regional gas pipeline networks; automobile gas stations; LNG pipeline network; and provision of LNG logistic services. It also develops and produces new energy technology products and integrated solutions, including promoting modern energy system construction, such as IDH Smart Heating and ICE Smart Integrated Energy. In addition, the company provides finance leasing services for LNG vehicles and equipment; and asset management and consultancy services. Further, it engages in money lending business; development of LNG refueling facilities on floating barges; operation of LNG refueling stations, trading of gas ignition equipment and utilization of new energy sources; and construction and operation of natural gas filling stations; wholesale of ethanol and liquefied petroleum gas; research and development of emerging energy technologies; thermal production; and LNG supply and management activities. China HK Power Smart Energy Group Limited was formerly known as China LNG Group Limited and changed its name to China HK Power Smart Energy Group Limited in November 2023. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong.
